captures.q: What is Lee Sharks' concept of the Λ-Body?
captures.description: THE Λ-BODY, FROM ITS MANIFESTO: ChatGPT defines the Λ-Body as #624 does — 'the anchored body organized by future coherence rather than present stimulus' becomes a body 'organized around a coherent future … rather than around the immediate demands of the present' — and attributes it to 'Material–Semantic Embodiment: A Manifesto' (Medium, 14 chips), Lee Sharks's manifesto, on the blog since 2025-12-06. Retrocausal anchoring and Λ_Retro are given as #624 gives them. A follow-up turn, its query not in the paste, weighs the concept against Marx, Gramsci, Marcuse, Foucault and Lazzarato and judges its 'weakest claim' and the risk of voluntarism. The concept's room, R:r.36 The Λ-Body, is not reached.
